entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A young, ambitious Cabal apprentice and dementia summoner who finds the Mirari, takes over the Cabal, and is corrupted and dies.

entities.name: The First
entities.description: Head of the Cabal who is impressed by Chainer, is disarmed and banished to Aphetto.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A barbarian who becomes Chainer's friend and promises to take and guard the Mirari.

entities.name: Skellum
entities.description: Chainer's master, mentor and father figure, sacrificed in the pits.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: Mer ambassador who starts a civil war in the Mer Empire and schemes with Order and Cabal; defeated and trapped by Llawan's mages.

entities.name: Kirtar
entities.description: Order Lieutenant who comes into possession of the Mirari.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: Companion who leaves with Kamahl and Laquatus after Kirtar.

entities.name: Aboshan
entities.description: Mer emperor whose misuse of the artifact devastated the Mer Empire.

entities.name: Llawan
entities.description: Aboshan's wife who claims the throne of the seas.

entities.name: Fulla
entities.description: Character who escapes the Mer Empire with Laquatus.

entities.name: Turg
entities.description: Laquatus's jack, who died stopping Aboshan.

entities.name: Burke
entities.description: Synthetic fighting servant Chainer creates for Laquatus.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An orb of immense power whose call lures many and corrupts Chainer.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Power in Cabal City that Chainer comes to lead.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: Faction that tries to infiltrate Cabal City to rid it of the Cabal.

entities.name: Mer Empire
entities.description: Undersea empire plunged into civil war.

entities.name: Cabal City
entities.description: City overrun by dementia creatures.

entities.name: Aboshan Trench
entities.description: Submerged part of Otaria; main theatre of the Mer civil war.

entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: City to which Chainer banishes the First.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: Where Chainer and Kamahl travel to complete the ritual.

entities.name: Cabal Anniversary Games
entities.description: Games with the Mirari as prize that become a show for Chainer's glory.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: The conflict the novel depicts.

events.summary: Chainer finds the Mirari outside Cabal City and hands it to the First, who is impressed by his loyalty.
events.quote: Despite the temptations of the orb, he decides to hand it to the head of the Cabal
Kamahl and Chainer quickly become friends.

events.summary: Kamahl, Seton and Laquatus leave after Kirtar, who has the sphere; Chainer resumes training under Skellum.
events.quote: Chainer resumes his training as a dementia summoner under his master Skellum

events.summary: The Mirari returns to the First, who makes it the prize of the Cabal Anniversary Games; Chainer and Kamahl train as a duo; Llawan claims the throne of the seas.
events.quote: Aboshan's wife Llawan claims the throne of the seas

events.summary: Laquatus starts a civil war in the Mer Empire and schemes with both Order and Cabal; the First sacrifices Skellum in the pits, devastating Chainer.
events.quote: In his plotting, he sacrifices Skellum, who dies in the pits to appease them.

events.summary: Chainer completes his initiation in Krosa with Kamahl and becomes a full dementia summoner able to master the Mirari; he creates Burke for Laquatus.
events.quote: he becomes a full-fledged dementia summoner.

events.summary: Chainer disarms the First, fails to kill him, banishes him to Aphetto and takes control of the Cabal, showing signs of corruption.
events.quote: He, therefore, banishes him to Aphetto

events.summary: The Games become a show for Chainer; he loses control of dementia creatures, who overrun the city; he draws them into himself and is corrupted, and makes Kamahl promise to take the Mirari.
events.quote: makes Kamahl promise to take it and keep it safe, away from misuse.

events.summary: Laquatus's army is defeated in the Aboshan Trench and Llawan's mages trap him in a bubble; he swears revenge.
events.quote: Llawan's mages create a bubble that entraps him and what remains of his followers in it.

events.summary: Kamahl tearfully witnesses Chainer's death and takes the Mirari as promised.
events.quote: Kamahl tearfully witnesses Chainer's death and takes the Mirari, as promised.

relations.note: His master, whom Chainer loves as a father.
relations.quote: whom he loves deeply and considers as a mentor and father

relations.note: Friends who fight together in the pits.
relations.quote: Kamahl and Chainer quickly become friends.
Aboshan's wife Llawan claims the throne of the seas

relations.note: Contests the throne; his army is trapped by her mages.
relations.quote: Llawan's mages create a bubble that entraps him

relations.note: Plots revenge for Skellum's death and banishes the First.
relations.quote: Chainer, however, plots revenge for the death of Skellum

relations.note: Installed as new head of the Cabal.
relations.quote: Chainer installs as the new leader
